title: Browse pointer text catalogs
changes: Add a wiki view for pointer text entries selected by reader and language, preserving aliases, original glyph IDs and control bytes.
Render referenced extracted glyphs and mark unavailable glyphs; reject invalid pointer indices without affecting other views.
validation: Synthetic unit rom-data-viewer-pointer-text-dl67rv3e passed generator and Linux Chrome checks for aliases, invalid indices, selection, glyph pixels, controls and wiki links.

Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-pointer-eur-dphvwy1l compared nine readers, 45 language tables, all 16100 strings and 118 referenced font glyphs with extracted sources, and checked the final selection in Chrome.
limitations: Control bytes and dynamic substitutions are labeled but not executed. Relative archive programs in the same source file still lack a dedicated preview.
